Appreciate the clear scope. We can definitely run this PoC. Quick notes and asks from our side:

1) Kickoff timing — I can lead a 75m hands-on workshop on Oct 12 at 10:00 PST or Oct 15 at 14:00 PST. Please pick whichever works for your engineers and ops.

2) Dedicated vs Hosted — from an ops perspective, Dedicated gives you predictable throughput and isolated KV cache behavior for routing tests. Hosted is faster to stand up but may require conservative quota bumps for sustained load. What matters more: isolation or time-to-first-test?

3) Token budget perspective — rough starting suggestion for your summarization flow (3 steps, avg 1.2k tokens/input, expansion to ~3.5k tokens/output per user): plan for ~1.5M tokens/day for a 2-week internal stress window. I’ll have Rishi and Karthik confirm with exact rate-limit and burst guidance.

4) Runbook review — can we do a 30m ops-only sync on Oct 11? We’ll walk through canary routing, KV cache warm-up, and load-test ramp schedule. I’ll attach our lab runbook (draft).

I’m looping in Rishi (service limits) and Karthik (orchestration + routing) so they can propose formal quota numbers.

Cheers,

Hi all —

Thanks, Kim. A few specifics from the limits/ops side:

- Baseline quota (hosted): 500 QPS sustained across 8 GPUs; burst to 2k QPS for short periods with autoscaling. Hosted trial will need a quota bump request to reach burst levels — expect a 24–48h lead.
- Dedicated (recommended for BrightBank): we can reserve a small pool (4x A100-equivalent) with guaranteed 800 QPS sustained; burst policies can be configured locally with 1.5x throughput for 10–15min windows.
- Token budgeting: for the run you described, 1.5M tokens/day is a sensible starting point. If you plan to run concurrent user simulations, increase to 3M tokens/day. We can add a guardrail alarm at 80% consumption.
- Load test plan: ramp over 30 minutes with steady-state for 20 minutes, run two increments (50% and 100% target). We'll capture p95/p99 latencies, KV hit rate, and token burn by step.

If BrightBank confirms Dedicated, Monica and I will provision the pool and share a pre-prod endpoint for your lab. If they choose Hosted, schedule the quota bump ASAP.

-rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Tech Ops, Redwood Inference
